say:2:1041566501:0.text: Hey, you! Finally, someone with an actual sense of fashion around here!
say:2:1041566501:0.source_cn: 哇哦，真难得，在这里能碰上懂时尚的人！

say:3:1041566502:0.text: You don't look half bad yourself! I was starting to think I was the only one with decent style around here!
say:3:1041566502:0.source_cn: 你也不错啊，难得能见到打扮品味一致的朋友！

say:4:1041566503:0.text: Everyone in the Ashen Wastes knows me as Rhys. Where are you from?
say:4:1041566503:0.source_cn: 你混哪边的？你要是到荒角沙漠这边，就报我诡草的大名！

say:5:1041566504:0.text: Me? Oh, I just wander wherever the wind takes me. Work when I'm hungry, play when I'm not.
say:5:1041566504:0.source_cn: 我？我哪里都逛逛，饿了就挣点钱，不饿就玩！

say:6:1041566505:0.text: The desert, huh? It's too sunny and sandy for me. Also, Boomboom told me there's an annoying guy who lives there...
say:6:1041566505:0.source_cn: 沙漠啊，太晒了吧，又到处都是沙子，而且阿爆说那边有个烦...

say:7:1041566506:0.text: You don't need to worry about a thing. Travel with me through the wastes, and trouble won't dare show its face.
say:7:1041566506:0.source_cn: 你放心，在沙漠有我在，不管什么人找麻烦都不用怕！

say:8:1041566507:0.text: Oh, just you wait! I'll take you for a ride on my Plumecharger! Fastest beast in the entire desert!
say:8:1041566507:0.source_cn: 到时候我带你坐坐炽翼冲锋者，他可是全沙漠速度第一！

say:9:1041566508:0.text: Plumecharger, huh? I like the name of your mount.
say:9:1041566508:0.source_cn: 哦！这就是炽翼冲锋者吗？你给坐骑起的名字也很帅啊！

say:10:1041566509:0.text: He's not only my mount but also my partner and best friend!
say:10:1041566509:0.source_cn: 不止是坐骑，还是我的哥们儿，伙伴，朋友！

say:11:1041566510:0.text: Oh, I totally understand. I have a friend like that! Boomboom!
say:11:1041566510:0.source_cn: 我明白我明白，我也有这样的好朋友！就是我刚刚说的阿爆！

say:12:1041566511:0.text: You've got an eye for style and a heart of gold! Honestly, girls like you—I mean people like you are a dying breed these days.
say:12:1041566511:0.source_cn: 你不仅懂时尚，还懂义气！如今这样的人越来越少见了！

say:13:1041566512:0.text: Those annoying grey beards keep nagging me about my clothes. They don't understand fashion at all!
say:13:1041566512:0.source_cn: 那帮烦人的老家伙一天到晚说什么奇装异服的，根本不懂时尚嘛！

say:14:1041566513:0.text: Yes! Those old farts need to shut up!
say:14:1041566513:0.source_cn: 没错！总有一天，得让那帮过时的老家伙们闭嘴！
